source.title: JiME Enemy Stats, Activations and Modifiers v1.4

attacks.text: A Goblin lunges at you, shrieking with rage.
A Goblin's dagger slices through the air.
A Goblin sweeps its spear in wide arcs in an attempt to disarm you.
attacks.effect: If you suffer {Damage}, discard 1 prepared card.

attacks.text: You struggle to endure the stench of the Goblin band as they surround you.
attacks.effect: After this attack, flip 2 {Fear} faceup.

attacks.text: Panicking, the lone Goblin slashes at you in a frenzy.
attacks.effect: If you suffer no {Damage} or {Fear} from this attack, gain 1 boon.

attacks.text: A Goblin grabs you and pulls you close. The stink of its breath is overpowering.
attacks.effect: After this attack, discard 1 inspiration.

attacks.text: Your attacker's bone armour clatters as they attack, the sound as chilling as funeral bells.
A Goblin scans the shadows, sees you, and leaps forward.
attacks.effect: After this attack, if you are in darkness, flip 2 {Fear} faceup.

attacks.text: One Goblin whirls around, snarling, as another Goblin appears to flank you. It's a trap!
attacks.effect: If you take no {Damage} or {Fear} from this attack, become emboldened.

attacks.text: A Goblin's hardened leather armour has the scars of many battles, and they respond to each of your maneuvers with skill to match.
attacks.effect: After this attack, discard 1 prepared card.

attacks.text: A thin Goblin lets out an ear-splitting cry, trying to unnerve you. You stand your ground, fixing an icy stare at the wretched creature.
attacks.effect: If you suffer no {Damage} or {Fear} from this attack, gain 1 inspiration.

attacks.text: A Goblin parries your weapon, forcing it low, and putting you off balance. The Goblin smiles a terrible smile, knowing the attack has caught you off your guard.
Your foe's curved blades glint with the promise of your demise.
A man unsheathes a huge sword and attacks!
A ruffian circles around you to find an opening. He wields a dagger caked with the dried blood of its previous victims.
A warrior moves with blinding speed, slashing at you in wide arcs.
attacks.effect: After this attack, flip 2 {Damage} faceup.

attacks.text: Your foe swings a heavy warhammer as easily as he would swing a toy wooden sword.
A ruffian brandishes a jagged knife. The blade, although rusted in places, looks very sharp.
attacks.effect: If you suffer {Damage} from this attack, gain 1 weakness and shuffle it into your deck.

attacks.text: A dagger slices through the air as the woman kicks and strikes at you.
attacks.effect: After this attack, discard 1 prepared card.

attacks.text: A ruffian strikes two swords together with a frightening clang.
You stare with a steely resolve as your foe advances with practiced swings of a club.
attacks.effect: If you suffer {Damage} from this attack, become emboldened.

attacks.text: An assailant jabs a nasty-looking sword at you.
Your foe gives you a sniff of disdain before unsheathing a gleaming longsword.
Your foes swing bone-shattering truncheons high and low, trying to give you no means of escape.
An Orc raises its weapons overhead and bares jagged teeth.
An Orc's massive hands grip the handle of a wicked-looking axe.
The Orc's crooked back and elongated arms are the stuff of nightmares.
An Orc leaps forward, shouting in a garbled tongue.
attacks.effect: If you suffer {Fear}, discard 2 inspiration.

attacks.text: An Orc hefts a blade in its two thick hands.
An Orc spots you, and its low, guttural chuckle fills you with dread.
An Orc charges you, bellowing in an attempt to frighten you into submission.
attacks.effect: If you suffer any {Damage} from this attack, you and the Orc Marauder move 1 space toward the closest threat token, if possible.

attacks.text: An Orc pulls a dagger from its boot and throws it at your head.
attacks.effect: If you suffer {Damage} from this attack, suffer 1 additional facedown {Damage}.

attacks.text: An Orc beats its chest with a heavy fist, then rushes at you.
The Orc's blades dance and swirl in a complicated pattern.
An Orc snorts with exertion as it hefts a heavy axe.
An Orc screams a phrase of such profane intensity you are sure you have been cursed.
attacks.effect: After this attack, discard 1 inspiration.

attacks.text: An Orc fires several times, and the first arrow whistles dangerously close to your head.
The Orcs heft crude spears and throw them with fearsome accuracy.
attacks.effect: If you suffer {Fear}, discard 1 inspiration.

attacks.text: A hunter nocks an arrow and takes aim at you. His fangs glisten with murderous intent.
An Orc raises a great yew bow and pulls back the string. Two arrows fly toward you at once.
An Orc looses several arrows in quick succession.
An Orc effortlessly throws a spear as thick as a tree branch at you.
attacks.effect: After this attack, suffer 1 facedown {Damage}.

attacks.text: An Orc draws back the string on its bow and fires a deadly arrow.
An Orc's arrowhead is glistening with a viscous liquid.
attacks.effect: If you suffer {Damage} from this attack, discard determined. If you cannot, gain 1 weakness and shuffle it into your deck.

attacks.text: An Orc appraises you with a dark, murderous look.
An Orc shrieks a garbled battlecry and raises a spear above its head.
attacks.effect: After this attack, discard 1 inspiration.

attacks.text: An Orc fires several crude arrows at once, their fletchings whistling through the air.
The Orc has you cornered, and finally takes one deadly shot at your heart.
A beast's yellowed fangs glisten with fresh blood.
A beast swipes at your face with paws as big as wagon wheels and tipped with dark claws.
A Warg gives a low, silky growl that sends a chill down your back.
A beast slashes at you with its thick claws.
A giant beast charges you, slavering for your blood.
attacks.effect: After this attack, discard 1 inspiration.

attacks.text: A Warg lashes out, biting at your hands and face.
A beast lunges at you, its claws slicing through the air.
The Wargs circle you and attempts to attack you from behind.
attacks.effect: After this attack, discard 1 prepared card.

attacks.text: You stand your ground as the horrifying Warg growls through bared fangs.
attacks.effect: If you suffer no {Fear} from this attack, become emboldened.

attacks.text: A monstrous wolf lunges at you with a flurry of teeth and claws.
A stench rises from the Warg's pelt, and as it closes in on you, you can feel its growl deep in your bones.
The Warg's jaws snap close with the force of a felling axe.
attacks.effect: After this attack, gain 1 weakness and place it on the bottom of your deck.

attacks.text: A creature grips a blackened sword in one sinewy hand.
The monster gnashes its teeth, biting at your hands and arms.
Two points of green light within a Wight's skull burn with hatred as it stares you down.
A figure moves like mist, circling around you as its knife slashes through the air.
attacks.effect: After this attack, discard 1 inspiration.

attacks.text: Gauzy strips of blood-stained fabric seem to beckon you toward the horrifying things.
attacks.effect: After this attack, discard 1 prepared card.

attacks.text: The monster draws a broadsword from its scabbard, gripping it with cadaverous hands.
A Wight pulls a curved dagger from beneath its ragged black robes and thrusts it at you.
The monster's long arms wrap around you, bony fingers scrabbling for purchase on your flesh.
attacks.effect: Suffer 1 additional facedown {Fear} from this attack.

attacks.text: You can feel a cold light pulling at your mind, drawing you nearer to the horror.
Your skin prickles with cold as a creature darts toward you, blade flashing in the light of its eyes.
attacks.effect: After this attack, discard 1 inspiration.

attacks.text: Even at a distance, you swear you feel the cold claws of the Wight gripping your throat.
The Wight opens its jaws, but the sound it makes is so far from that of a man you can feel tears wet on your cheeks.
The troll bears a club in one boulder-sized hand.
The stench emanating from the troll is overwhelming.
The troll punches at you with heavy, clumsy swings.
The monster snatches up a nearby boulder and throws it at you with surprising accuracy.
The troll's scarred arms flex as it swings the club through the air.
The troll tracks your movements with flat, angry eyes.
attacks.effect: After this attack, discard 1 inspiration.

attacks.text: You stand your ground, and the troll grins in acceptance of your challenge.
attacks.effect: If you suffer no {Fear} from this attack, become determined.

attacks.text: The beast bellows as it crashes into you.
attacks.effect: After this attack, discard 1 prepared card.

attacks.text: The troll smashes a heavy fist into the ground near you and tries to grab you with its other arm.
The troll picks up a club as big around as you are and swings it with menacing ease.
You dodge and roll, attempting to stay away from the titanic feet of the troll.
The beast tears at the ground in its frenzy for your blood.
The spider rears back, stabbing at you with several clawed legs.
The unnatural movements of the spider are difficult to track.
After trapping you with its many legs, the spider slams its bulbous body down again and again.
attacks.effect: If you suffer any {Damage} from this attack, discard all boons.

attacks.text: The beast dodges your defenses, spraying sticky web beneath your feet.
The spider has dripping fangs that strike quick as lightning.
Webs coat the area around you, and tripping will put you at the spider's mercy.
attacks.effect: After this attack, flip 1 {Damage} faceup.

attacks.text: The spider hesitates to attack outright, waiting for your guard to be lowered.
attacks.effect: After this attack, discard 1 inspiration.

attacks.text: The Goblin uses its strength to hurl projectiles at your defenses.
The stench emanating from the Goblin is overwhelming.
The Goblin hurls heavy stones and debris at your head.
attacks.effect: If you suffer any {Damage} from this attack, discard 1 inspiration.

attacks.text: The Goblin attacks you with dogged persistence and deadly aim.
Grunting with effort, the Goblin hurls an enormous rock into the air, hoping to squish you.
The Goblin tracks your movements with flat, angry eyes.
You stand your ground and the Goblin takes aim at your chest.
attacks.effect: If you suffer no {Fear} from this attack, become determined.

attacks.text: The taskmaster uses its bulk and equipment to bludgeon your defenses.
A cruel gleam in the taskmaster's eye convinces you that evasion will be key to your survival.
The Orc pummels you with fists the size of cook pots.
attacks.effect: After this attack, flip 2 {Damage} faceup.

attacks.text: The taskmaster blows a call on a curved horn, and it sends a chill down your spine.
attacks.effect: Each other Orc and Goblin moves 1 space toward the closest hero.

attacks.text: The taskmaster is slow, but each of its attacks could fell a much larger target than you.
The Orc growls, enjoying the gleam of fear in your eyes.
The taskmaster howls orders in a guttural language before renewing its assault.
attacks.effect: Each hero in a space with an Orc or Goblin suffers 1 facedown {Damage}.

attacks.text: The spectral warrior fights with untiring grace.
The shadowman seems to waver in and out of existence, only corporeal at the moment of striking.
You feel the chill of the grave all around you, leeching the hope out of your heart.
attacks.effect: After this attack, flip 2 {Fear} faceup.

attacks.text: The ghostly light around your foe is painful to behold.
attacks.effect: If you suffer any {Fear} from this attack, shuffle 1 weakness into your deck.

attacks.text: The shadowman slashes furiously with a sword as sharp as new-forged steel.
Your foe is ghastly to behold, and fights with unflagging discipline.
The ghostly soldier must have trained long hours in life to be so precise and devastating with each blow.
attacks.effect: After this attack, discard all boons.

attacks.text: The giant worm blindly slams its body about, trying to squash you under its bulk.
With large gnashing pincers, the beast lashes out, seemingly at random.
Nothing you have ever seen prepared you for this ancient monster. It is a thing of nightmares.
attacks.effect: After this attack, flip 2 {Fear} faceup.

attacks.text: Beastly strength paired with ancient instinct lead the creature to attack.
attacks.effect: After this attack, discard 1 inspiration.

attacks.text: The ground around the beast roils and shifts.
Your foe is enormous, striking wildly and half-blind.
The terrifying worm strikes again and again.
attacks.effect: After this attack, flip 1 {Damage} faceup.

attacks.text: The lumbering beast attacks with ferocity.
You notice a pattern to your foe's attacks, and you anticipate a massive swing aimed at your head.
The cave troll has fists like rocks with filthy fingernails.
attacks.effect: If you suffer any {Damage} from this attack, flip 1 {Fear} faceup.

attacks.text: Staying light on your feet seems to confuse the troll, as if it has trouble tracking your darting movement.
attacks.effect: If you suffer no {Damage} or {Fear} from this attack, become emboldened.

attacks.text: The cave troll relies on its superior bulk, and if even one blow lands true, you will regret it.
Your foe seems to have weak vision, relying on other senses to find you. It might be possible to exploit that.
The troll hammers at your defenses, leaving no time to catch your breath.
attacks.effect: After this attack, discard all boons.

attacks.text: The foot soldier strikes with sweeping blows, designed to drive you back and cut through your defenses.
Your foe uses weaving motions to force you to step lightly to avoid the wickedly sharp blade.
The soldier hacks downward with their entire strength, using the full length of the polearm they wield.
attacks.effect: After this attack, if there is more than 1 enemy figure in this space, discard 1 prepared card.

attacks.text: Fighting a combatant with a polearm forces you to choose between stepping in close to entangle their reach, or staying at a distance to better react to their movements.
attacks.effect: Before this attack, each hero in a space with a soldier enemy group suffers 1 {Damage}.

attacks.text: The soldier has drilled hours upon hours with their weapon, and their smooth movements leave no opening for escape.
attacks.effect: After this attack, if another enemy group is nearby, become captured.

attacks.text: As a flurry of blows hammers your defenses, you are forced to admit that this soldier is a fierce warrior.
attacks.effect: Before this attack, each hero in a space with a soldier enemy group gains 1 inspiration. Each hero with a Soldier skill prepared scouts 1.

attacks.text: Your foe attacks with discipline and battle fury in equal measure, their deadly blade tracing a web of steel around you.
attacks.effect: When you test to negate, if you have a tactic prepared, add 1 {Success}.

attacks.text: Fiercer than their Orc cousins, the Uruk have no fear of pain, fighting with reckless fervor.
attacks.effect: If you reveal at least 1 {Fate} during this test, suffer 2 facedown {Damage}.

attacks.text: The Uruk's attacks are unpredictable and wild, but still possible to deflect for a skilled warrior.
Attacking with doubled fists, the Uruk hammers your defenses with overwhelming might.
attacks.effect: If you have a {2H} item equipped, prevent 2 {Damage}.

attacks.text: Your foe snarls a challenge, ready for whatever tricks you plan to use to evade their grasp.
In close combat, the bulk of the Uruk is sometimes all you can see, leaving you isolated and desperate.
attacks.effect: If you reveal at least 1 {Fate} during this test, become terrified.

attacks.text: The longer reach of the Uruk leaves little room to maneuver in combat.
With a massive roar, the Uruk charges!
attacks.effect: After this attack, discard 1 inspiration.

attacks.text: Its snake-like neck gives the fell beast both reach and flexibility to find the openings in your defenses.
attacks.effect: This attack affects each hero in the enemy's space.

attacks.text: Hissing a warning, the fell beast lashes its tail behind you.
attacks.effect: If you suffer any {Damage} from this attack, become terrified.

attacks.text: Tracking both the toothy maw and whipping tail of the beast, you almost miss the strike from one taloned foot!
attacks.effect: If you suffer any {Fear} from this attack, become terrified.

attacks.text: The screech of the beast is as terrible as its fearsome bite.
attacks.effect: After this attack, discard 2 inspiration or become terrified.

attacks.text: A dread presence surrounds the fell beast, weighing heavy on you like dark chains.
attacks.effect: Before this attack, gain 2 inspiration if you have a [i]valour[/i] skill prepared.

attacks.text: Teeth like daggers snap close around you.
The beast can attack from any angle, using teeth and tail and claw.
Each stone from the Goblin's sling seems to strike where you are weakest.
attacks.effect: If this enemy is in your space, discard 1 prepared skill after this attack.

attacks.text: Dodging both the Goblin's hurled stones and the snapping jaws of the Warg strains your muscles to their limit.
attacks.effect: If this enemy is in your space and you suffer any {Damage} from this attack, become captured.

attacks.text: You aren't sure whether the ravenous beast or the cackling Goblin that rides it is the more dangerous.
attacks.effect: If this enemy is in your space and you suffer any {Damage} from this attack, become captured.

attacks.text: The Warg tilts its head back and howls, long and eerie in a sudden lull of battle.
attacks.effect: After this attack, if this enemy is in your space, discard 1 prepared skill.

attacks.text: Rider and mount circle you, looking for an opening in your defense.
attacks.effect: After this attack, move this enemy group 1 space away from you.

attacks.text: Each attack is swift and brutal, leaving you reeling while the Warg retreats to a safe distance again.
attacks.effect: After this attack, move this enemy group 1 space away from you.

attacks.text: Howling with one voice, the beast and its rider strike and circle away.
attacks.effect: After this attack, move this enemy group 1 space away from you.

attacks.text: The siege engine itself is slow, but the warriors within have deadly aim.
attacks.effect: After this attack, each hero in a space with an enemy discards 1 inspiration.

attacks.text: The crew of the siege engine looses a flight of arrows. The attack signals the other soldiers on the field to press the advantage.
attacks.effect: After this attack, each hero suffers {Damage} equal to the number of enemy figures in their space, {Might} negates.

attacks.text: You cannot know how many warriors man the siege tower, but each attack follows the last with swift discipline. You are hard-pressed to keep your defenses up.
attacks.effect: After this attack, each hero suffers {Damage} equal to the number of enemy figures in their space, {Agility} negates.

attacks.text: A cloud of arrows bursts from the siege tower in every direction, darkening the skies.
attacks.effect: This attack affects each nearby hero.

attacks.text: Your foes use every opportunity to disrupt your battle formations with their superior vantage.
attacks.effect: After this attack, each hero in a space with an enemy discards 1 inspiration.

attacks.text: A horn draws your attention to the top of the siege tower, where a flag marked with a dark helm has been raised. Immediately after, your enemies attack with renewed ferocity!
attacks.effect: After this attack, each enemy without {Ranged} moves 1 space toward the closest hero.

attacks.text: The area around the siege tower is nearly impassable for you or your allies, hidden archers sure to rain death on those who approach.
attacks.effect: After this attack, each enemy without {Ranged} moves 1 space toward the closest hero.

attacks.text: Thundering and crashing, the oliphaunt tramples everything underfoot.
attacks.effect: This attack affects each hero in the enemy's space. After this enemy's activation, move all other enemies in its space to the adjacent space with the most heroes.

attacks.text: The swinging tusks of the oliphaunt force you to dodge again and again.
attacks.effect: This attack affects each hero in this enemy's space. After this enemy's activation, move all other enemies in its space to the adjacent space with the most heroes.

attacks.text: Spears hurled by warriors mounted on the back of the oliphaunt fly through the air around you!
attacks.effect: If you suffer no {Damage} or {Fear} from this attack, become emboldened. After this enemy's activation, move all other enemies in its space to the adjacent space with the most heroes.

attacks.text: As massive as the oliphaunt is, its feet move with shocking speed and crushing weight.
attacks.effect: If you suffer any {Damage} from this attack, flip 1 {Fear} faceup. After this enemy's activation, move all other enemies in its space to the adjacent space with the most heroes.

attacks.text: The oliphaunt rears back and slams its whole weight down, causing the earth to tremble like the skin of a beaten drum.
attacks.effect: After this attack, discard 1 prepared card. After this enemy's activation, move all other enemies in its space to the adjacent space with the most heroes.

attacks.text: Short charges bring the oliphaunt's tusks around to spear its target while keeping all other threats at a distance.
attacks.effect: This attack affects each hero in this enemy's space. After this enemy's activation, move all other enemies in its space to the adjacent space with the most heroes.

attacks.text: Quick as a striking snake, the oliphaunt grabs you with its trunk and hurls you to the ground.
attacks.effect: If you suffer any {Damage} from this attack, place your hero in the adjacent space with the fewest other heroes. After this enemy's activation, move all other enemies in its space to the adjacent space with the most heroes.
